name: baseUrl
label: Base URL
help: Enter the root URL of your Datto RMM API instance (without /api/v2/). Find this in your Datto RMM account under Setup > API.

pattern.message: Please enter a valid URL starting with https://

name: apiSecret
label: API secret
placeholder: Enter the Datto RMM API secret key
